ghost.glb: the Bot body of the /xr page (second body).

Every point in this file was worked out by code from one input: the outline of the
Kiro ghost mark, website/src/assets/kiro-ghost-mark.svg, which is this repository's
own art. The code that worked it out (a sculpting script and the modules beside it)
is not in this repository; the file is its whole output.

No model, no scan and no other party's data went into the file. It holds no texture
and no picture. So it carries no licence of its own beyond this repository's.

The things a Bot can wear (the file's second scene, "wardrobe") were shaped by the
same code after the dashboard's own avatar art, website/src/lib/kiroGhostAvatar.ts.

Tools that ran while it was made. None of them is in the file:
  Python 3.12 (PSF-2.0), NumPy 2.5.5 (BSD-3-Clause), SciPy 1.18.1 (BSD-3-Clause),
  Pillow 13.0.0 (MIT-CMU).
